🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 26/30: ICC2 / Fusion Compiler Commands – Work Smart, Debug Faster!

Command knowledge is an essential skill for a VLSI Physical Design Engineer. The right commands help us analyze the design, identify violations, optimize PPA, debug issues, and accelerate timing closure.

Flow: report_timing ➔ report_qor ➔ report_congestion ➔ Optimization ➔ Verify.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 26: ICC2 & Fusion Compiler Commands

content: Excited to share insights on Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) and timing closure in 32nm ASIC implementation. Balancing skew vs insertion delay while fixing hold violations with multi-VT standard cells.
Completed RTL-to-GDSII tape-out simulation of a 32-bit RISC-V processor core using Synopsys Fusion Compiler & ICC2. Clean DRC/LVS signoff with zero setup/hold timing violations.
Presented our autonomous hardware system at National Level Technical Symposia. Demonstrating real-time edge processing and robust silicon-level power planning.
